column1: # Where every control sits on the XDJ-AZ's top panel.
# Measured on the manufacturer's top-panel line drawing at 2742 x 1518 px, the
# panel's reference size (see ASPECT in src/panel.rs): circles by a least-squares
# fit to their outer edge, rectangles by their outer border, a few by hand
# (deck select, IN/CUE and OUT, the jog, the browse cluster's four curved keys,
# the faders), and by hand again where the fit took printed shading or a
# neighbor's line for an edge (BEAT JUMP, BEAT SYNC, LOAD, CH SELECT 1 and CF.A,
# MIXER SETTINGS, the X-PAD strip, the tempo frame, the USB slots).
# x, y = center; w, h = outer size; all in those pixels. Faders: the track row's
# h is the cap's travel (the cap's center moves between its ends).
# Not measured: the screen's housing (panel.tower, top.bezel, top.lcd) and the
# screen-tab row. The tabs sit near the housing's top and the bezel is narrow, so
# the live screen is as large as the housing allows; the deck's own bezel is wider.
# The right deck repeats the left one shifted right by deck_r_dx: the XDJ-AZ's
# decks are copies, not mirror images. build.rs turns this file into
# The optional last field describes the control's look, measured on the same
# drawing (lengths in its pixels, angles in degrees clockwise from 3 o'clock):
#   rings=r,...        concentric outlines, center out (radial profile)
#   fill=0-r           a filled disc at the center
#   grips=n@r          a knurled band of n grips (angular FFT of the band)
#   scallop=n@r0-r1    a scalloped skirt of n lobes
#   dots=r:a,...       a knob's printed scale dots
#   arc=r,w:a-b,...    a knob's printed range arc
#   corner=r           a rectangle's corner radius (median of its family)
#   segs=n:len         a level meter's n segments, each len long (segment boxes
#   path=x,y ...       a traced outline, relative to the center (contour of the
#   hub, ovals, smalls   the jog's center band and the grip ring around the platter
